title: Draft a Simple Motion to Stay Surplus Distribution
instructions:
Draft a short motion to stay distribution of foreclosure surplus funds. ALL facts you need are provided here — do not search for anything else. Write the motion to a file named `motion.md` in the output directory.

FACTS (use these exactly):
- Court: Montgomery County Court of Common Pleas
- Case No: 2025 CV 04438
- Party: Rodney D. Mullins, pro se
- Surplus amount: $94,452.62
- Competing claim by AUSA Adam Tieger (DOJ/HUD) with no evidence
- Foreclosure decree is void ab initio
- FedEx service defect under Ohio Civ.R. 4.1(A)(1)(b)
- Fraudulent Suggestion of Death filed by Fornash
- Sheriff's sale executed during stayed appeal

Structure the motion with: (1) caption, (2) statement of facts, (3) argument, (4) prayer for relief, (5) certificate of service.
